description: Thirteen floors in five bulges, the top one noticeably smaller than the bottom one, with a chrome collar at every pinch. The board by the door still lists the launch terms: no chain, no onward purchase, completion in twenty-eight days. Every one of those was true and the building is a third occupied anyway. The door beside the board is open during the day and there is a desk visible through it with somebody behind it, which is the only building on this street where that is true.
